paras: Leptosiaphos dewittei, also known commonly as De Witte's five-toed skink, De Witte's leaf-litter skink, and Witte's five-toed skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is indigenous to Central Africa.
The specific name, dewittei, is in honor of Belgian herpetologist Gaston-François de Witte.
L. dewittei is found in Angola and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
